text_simplified: This text discusses the importance of ihsan (excellence in worship and conduct) in the tarbiyah of girls and boys. It points out that ihsan is not only in providing food and drink but also in tarbiyah, education, and preserving chastity. It also clarifies that raising girls to obey Allah and stay away from what is forbidden is one of the greatest means of happiness and peace. It warns against taking children to places of amusement and play that may corrupt their hearts.

review_defects.why: The English adds a parenthetical definition not present in the Arabic source. The Arabic simply says 'الإحسان' without explaining it.
The English adds 'providing', which is implied but not explicitly stated in the Arabic. The Arabic says 'in food and drink'.
The Arabic uses the ordinary word 'التربية' (upbringing/education), but the English transliterates it as 'tarbiyah', making the text more jargon-heavy and less direct than the source.
